title: Walnut Biscotti Crusted French Toast
description: A French-inspired breakfast dish, crusted with crushed biscotti and walnuts, perfect for a weekend brunch.
instructions: In a shallow dish, whisk together eggs, milk, and maple syrup.
Heat a non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Dip each bread slice into the egg mixture, coating both sides.
Place the bread slices in the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side.
In a separate pan, melt 2 tbsp of butter over low heat.
Add the crushed biscotti and chopped walnuts to the pan and cook, stirring constantly, for 2-3 minutes or until lightly toasted.
Transfer the cooked French toast to a serving plate and top with the walnut biscotti crust.
Drizzle with remaining butter and sprinkle with cinnamon and nutmeg.
